requirements.title: Required files
requirements.description: Set one rule per file. Keep the example and change name, kind (text/json/csv) and maxBytes. For CSV, supply csv.headers in the expected order; minRows/maxRows are optional. For JSON, jsonSchema is optional.

files.title: File contents — paste text directly
files.description: Add a filename and paste its UTF-8 contents below. Match each filename to a required file. No JSON escaping is needed in the form. Apify stores cloud inputs; use synthetic or non-sensitive material.

prefill.name: test-report.md
prefill.content:
# Test record
Two synthetic records checked.

name.title: Filename
name.description: The exact filename used in Required files, such as result.json. This is a label, not a local path or URL.

content.title: File contents
content.description: Paste the JSON, CSV or text itself, preserving line breaks. Up to 1 MiB of UTF-8 bytes per file; 4 MiB total.

allowExtraFiles.title: Allow files outside the required list
allowExtraFiles.description: Extra files are rejected by default. Allowed extras are not checked against a contract.
